name: fabric
description: Deploys a Microsoft Fabric capacity with configurable SKU and admin membership.
what: A Microsoft Fabric capacity resource (Microsoft.Fabric/capacities) that provides dedicated compute for Fabric workloads. The template configures SKU size and required admin members.
why: Organizations using Fabric need a repeatable way to provision dedicated capacity for pilots, MVPs, and production analytics workloads with clear environment tagging.
potentialUseCases: Standing up a Fabric sandbox for analytics experimentation
Provisioning dedicated Fabric compute for a BI team
Establishing a production Fabric capacity with IaC

reliability: Infrastructure is repeatable and redeployable through Bicep
security: Admin membership is explicit and parameterized
No secrets are embedded in the template
costOptimization: Capacity SKU is parameterized from small (F2) to large tiers
Dev and prod parameter files separate cost profiles
operationalExcellence: Single template and parameters support consistent deployments
Standard outputs expose deployed capacity identifiers
performanceEfficiency: SKU can be tuned to workload demand
Higher production tiers can be selected without template rewrites

quota.summary: Fabric capacity availability and quota can vary by region and tenant. Validate service availability and entitlement before deployment.

requirements.detail: Your tenant/subscription must be allowed to create Fabric capacities in the target region.

components.name: Fabric capacity (F2, 2 CU)
components.notes: F2 = 2 capacity units x 730 hours at the per-CU-hour rate. Larger F-SKUs scale the CU count (F4=4, F64=64, ...); pause the capacity to stop compute billing.
